title: Beyond Expert Rankings: Contrast Calibration for Mixed-Precision MoE Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.20353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models activate only a few experts per token, yet all expert weights must be stored. Mixed-precision quantization reduces this storage cost by assigning higher bit-widths to sensitive experts and lower bit-widths to resilient ones, but expert rankings alone do not determine how strongly to weight their errors. To address this gap, we propose NatScale, a contrast-calibrated allocation framework for mixed-precision MoE quantization. It uses a model-specific power transformation to calibrate gradient-based expert weights to an information-theoretic contrast target while preserving rankings. We jointly evaluate each expert's gate, up and down configurations to estimate its output error. We then combine these errors and calibrated weights with an existing prior based on weight spectra, variance and precision decay to select configurations under a storage budget. translated_title: 超越专家排序：面向混合精度MoE量化的对比校准
translated_abstract: 混合专家语言模型在每个token上仅激活少数专家，但所有专家权重都必须被存储。混合精度量化通过为敏感专家分配更高位宽、为鲁棒专家分配更低位宽来降低这种存储成本，但仅凭专家排序并不能决定对其误差的加权强度。为填补这一空白，我们提出了NatScale，一个用于混合精度MoE量化的对比校准分配框架。它使用模型特定的幂变换，在保持排序不变的前提下，将基于梯度的专家权重校准到信息论对比度目标。我们联合评估每个专家的门控、上投影和下投影配置以估计其输出误差。然后，我们将这些误差与校准后的权重，同现有的基于权重谱、方差和精度衰减的先验相结合，在存储预算下选择配置。在三个模型上，NatScale取得了最低的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出NatScale框架，通过模型特定的幂变换将基于梯度的专家权重校准到信息论对比度目标，并联合评估门控与上下投影配置的输出误差，从而在存储预算下实现更优的混合精度MoE量化位宽分配。
en_tdlr: NatScale is a contrast-calibrated allocation framework that calibrates gradient-based expert weights to an information-theoretic contrast target via model-specific power transformations and jointly evaluates gate, up, and down configurations' output errors to achieve superior mixed-precision MoE quantization under storage budgets.
